text:
1 days ago Photo: Matthew Stockman / Getty Images Sport / Getty Images Bo Chapman Nix has a difficult matchup when his Denver Broncos face the Los Angeles Rams in Week 3 (Sunday, 8:20 p.m. ET). The Rams concede 167.5 passing yards per game, seventh-best in the NFL.
Bo Nix has 419 yards passing (209.5 per game) and has completed 66.1% of his throws (39-for-59) while throwing two TD passes and two picks. With his legs, Bo Chapman Nix has eight rushing yards on eight totes, averaging 4.0 rushing yards per game.

One player has thrown for three or more TDs in an outing against the Rams this season. The 167.5 passing yards the Rams allow per contest makes them the seventh-ranked pass defense in the league this season. Opponents of the Rams have put up three touchdowns through the air (1.5 per game). The Rams' defense is 15th in the NFL in that category. Catch NFL action all year long on Fubo.
Nix Passing Insights Nix has surpassed his passing yards prop total once in two chances. The Broncos have passed 57.8% of the time and run 42.2% this season. They rank 27th in the NFL in scoring. Nix's 7.1 yards per attempt rank 16th in the NFL. Bo Chapman Nix has thrown for a touchdown in all two games this year, but has zero games with multiple passing TDs. He has 66.7% of his team's three offensive touchdowns this season (two). Nix has passed seven times out of his 59 total attempts while in the red zone (43.8% of his team's red zone plays).
